ruling.instruction: Do the following in agent/extensions/_shared/ask-answers.ts. (1) Remove the record-level pre-check at lines 74-81. Read `timedOut` once, through the schema: after `const native = nativeDetails.safeParse(details)`, inside `if (native.success)` return null first when `native.data.timedOut === true`, then do the existing answers/notes loop. Keep the `timedOutKey` computed schema key if it is still what ties the key to `NativeAskToolDetails` (the `satisfies` pin plus the Equals assert); drop the second raw read. (2) Leave the legacy `results[]` and single `questionResult` branch untouched: no `timedOut` handling, so a top-level or per-result `timedOut: true` in a legacy record still yields its answer exactly as at 21d748d.
